name: xiao-s3-plus-expansion
title: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus + Expansion Board
notes: XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus (ESP32-S3R8, 16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM; same D0-D10 pinout as the XIAO ESP32S3) on the XIAO Expansion Board Base: SD slot CS D2/GPIO3 on SPI GPIO 7/8/9 (Seeed wiki). The XIAO's LED on GPIO21, active low. Wi-Fi only; for a wired node see the W5500 Ethernet Adapter entry.
